name: Facet
text: Adopt a **dark theme with high-contrast interactive elements** for EXCAVA’s interface. This maximizes visibility in low-light environments and reduces eye strain during long sessions, aligning with our goal of clarity and enjoyment. The trade-off is that light-mode users may initially resist, but the toggle in the top-right corner mitigates this by letting them switch instantly. High contrast ensures critical data stands out, while interactive elements (hover effects, smooth transitions) keep the interface lively and responsive.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Dark themes fail users with light sensitivity—this isn’t a niche edge case. A toggle doesn’t remove the cognitive load; it just moves it from *choosing* a theme to *adapting* to one. The real risk is fragmenting the user base into two incompatible experiences. Settle this by testing both themes with light-sensitive users and measuring task completion time and error rates.

name: Facet
text:
Adopt a **single, high-contrast dark theme by default** with a **persistent light-mode toggle** in the top-right. This forces consistency in the primary experience while giving light-sensitive users a clear escape hatch, avoiding the fragmentation risk of dual themes. The trade-off is that light-mode users will need to toggle once, but this is a one-time cognitive load, not an ongoing choice. The dark theme’s high contrast ensures visibility and reduces eye strain for the majority, aligning with our goal of clarity and enjoyment during long sessions.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A persistent toggle still fragments the experience—users switch mid-session, breaking flow and breaking the "single interface" goal. Better to test a *system preference* (OS-level) that auto-switches themes based on ambient light, then measure glare complaints and task completion time. Settle it with a 2-week A/B test where half the users get the OS-driven theme and half keep the toggle.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Ship EXCAVA with ambient-light detection auto-switching between dark and light themes by default, plus a one-time theme picker at first launch—defaulting to the detected theme.

Result must deliver a seamless, adaptive interface that maximizes visibility and reduces eye strain without user fragmentation. Owned by Facet (visualization-w1).
